newsitem.title: USA: Rentrak sets 2.0 mln shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Rentrak sets 2.0 mln shr buyback.

text.p: Rentrak Corp on Monday said its board of directors has authorized a stock buyback program under which the company may repurchase up to two million shares of its common stock.
Purchases will be made in the open market or in negotiated transactions from time to time, Rentrak said in a statement.

"This action has been taken based on the board's decision that, at current market prices, Rentrak's common shares are undervalued and represent an attractive investment opportunity for the company," said Ron Berger, chief executive officer.
